sources.note: Generated Pi distribution committed upstream: SKILL.md, reference/ playbooks, and supporting scripts (command-metadata.json, engine launcher, engine checksums, live browser helpers, font index, VERSION). Vendored byte-for-byte from the tagged commit's git tree.

Canonical agent-role instructions (impeccable-asset-producer, impeccable-documenter, impeccable-finish-reviewer, impeccable-manual-edit-applier). Upstream's Pi generator does not emit native Subagents definitions, so these are preserved verbatim and also exposed through the installed skill.
Upstream generator source template, kept for provenance of the generated SKILL.md.
Upstream third-party notices (platform-design-skills attribution), copied verbatim.

excluded.note: These upstream trees are intentionally not imported. Everything else about the skill/role distribution is vendored in full.
paths: website, documentation site, and browser extension trees (docs/, ui/, extension/, browser-bundle/)
Rust workspace and CLI (crates/, cli/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml)

other-harness build trees and plugin trees (.agent/, .agents/, .claude/, .claude-plugin/, .codex/, .cursor/, .cursor-plugin/, .devin/, .dsh/, .gemini/, .grok/, .hermes/, .impeccable/, .kiro/, .omp/, .opencode/, .qoder/, .rovodev/, .trae/, .trae-cn/, .veto/, .vibe/, plugin/, vscode/)
skill/reference/ and skill/scripts/ (generator inputs/outputs; their generated equivalents are vendored as pi-dist/reference and pi-dist/scripts)
native engine binaries and test fixtures (downloaded at runtime by scripts/impeccable and verified against scripts/engine-checksums.txt)
